# Module 4 Knowledge Check {.unnumbered}

This knowledge check covers the key learning outcomes from Module 4: Microbial Metabolism. Test your understanding of Biolog GEN III phenotypic characterization and metabolic profiling.

## Question 1: Purpose of Biolog GEN III Plates

What is the primary purpose of using Biolog GEN III MicroPlates?

- [ ] To measure bacterial cell size
- [ ] To test bacterial growth across 94 different metabolic conditions and carbon sources simultaneously
- [ ] To perform antibiotic sensitivity testing
- [ ] To identify bacterial species through morphology


## Question 2: Turbidimeter Use

What does a turbidimeter measure and why is it used in this protocol?

- [ ] It measures the age of the bacterial culture
- [ ] It measures light transmittance to adjust bacterial cell density to a standard inoculum concentration
- [ ] It detects genetic mutations
- [ ] It identifies which nutrients the bacteria can use


## Question 3: Inoculum Preparation

According to the protocol, what media is used to prepare the bacterial suspension for the Biolog plate?

- [ ] TSB (Tryptic Soy Broth)
- [ ] IF-A inoculating fluid
- [ ] BUG agar broth
- [ ] Distilled water


## Question 4: Biolog Plate Volume

How much inoculum is added to each well of the Biolog GEN III plate?

- [ ] 50 µL
- [ ] 100 µL
- [ ] 200 µL
- [ ] 250 µL


## Question 5: Incubation Conditions

Which of the following describes the incubation setup for Biolog plates in this protocol?

- [ ] All plates incubated statically only
- [ ] One plate in the plate reader with continuous monitoring, one incubated statically at 33°C
- [ ] All plates incubated with shaking
- [ ] All plates at room temperature in the dark


## Question 6: Metabolic Profile Interpretation

If the controls perform as expected but a test well in the Biolog plate shows no color development, what does this suggest?

- [ ] Contamination
- [ ] No detectable metabolic activity for that carbon source or condition under the assay conditions
- [ ] The plate was incubated incorrectly
- [ ] A pipetting error occurred


---

**Review these learning outcomes to deepen your understanding:**

- Explain the purpose of GEN III Biolog plates and metabolic tests
- Discuss the significance of growth curves
- Practice using a turbidimeter
- Collect and interpret growth data from Biolog GEN III plates

**Next Steps:** If you found any questions challenging, revisit the Biolog plate interpretation section and practice analyzing growth patterns.
